gloss: outskirts of town; edge of town

definitions.gloss: outskirts of town; edge of town
definitions.explanation: The area at the edge of a town where buildings thin out and the countryside begins.

examples.japanese: {町外|まちはず}れに{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live on the outskirts of town.

examples.japanese: {町外|まちはず}れに{古|ふる}いお{寺|てら}がある。
examples.english: There's an old temple on the edge of town.

examples.japanese: バスは{町外|まちはず}れの{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}で{最後|さいご}の{乗客|じょうきゃく}を{降|お}ろした。
examples.english: The bus dropped its last passenger at a stop on the outskirts of town.

notes:
Compound of {町|まち} (town) + {外|はず}れ (the far end, the part that falls outside). Refers to the thinly built-up margin of a town.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町外|まちはず}れに{住|す}む: to live on the outskirts
- {町外|まちはず}れの{家|いえ}: a house at the edge of town

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {郊外|こうがい}: suburbs — the residential belt around a city; {町外|まちはず}れ is the immediate, less developed edge of a town
